description: Hand-written adversarial requests over a deliberately ambiguous retail schema.

cases.question: List the names of all suppliers.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers

cases.question: What are the names of the stores in Lyon?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM stores WHERE city = 'Lyon'

cases.question: Which products are in the Tea category? Give their names.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM products T1 JOIN categories T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Tea'

cases.question: Show each product name together with its category name.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, T2.name FROM products T1 JOIN categories T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.id

cases.question: Which department does Alice Martin work in?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM employees T1 JOIN departments T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.id WHERE T1.name = 'Alice Martin'

cases.question: List the names of the regions.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM regions

cases.question: How many clients do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

cases.question: How many staff members work in the Engineering department?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees T1 JOIN departments T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Engineering'

cases.question: Which vendor is based in Japan?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'Japan'

cases.question: What is the price of the croissant?
gold_sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE name = 'Croissant'

cases.question: list every category
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM categories

cases.question: How many shops are there in each city?
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM stores GROUP BY city

cases.question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

cases.question: When was the Lille Central store opened?
gold_sql: SELECT opened FROM stores WHERE name = 'Lille Central'

cases.question: Which customers bought Croissants? List their names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM customers T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T2.customer_id = T1.id JOIN order_items T3 ON T3.order_id = T2.id JOIN products T4 ON T4.id = T3.product_id WHERE T4.name = 'Croissant'
SELECT T1.name FROM customers T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T2.customer_id = T1.id JOIN order_items T3 ON T3.order_id = T2.id JOIN products T4 ON T4.id = T3.product_id WHERE T4.name = 'Croissant'

cases.question: How many orders were placed in stores of the North region?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders T1 JOIN stores T2 ON T1.store_id = T2.id JOIN regions T3 ON T2.region_id = T3.id WHERE T3.name = 'North'

cases.question: Which suppliers provide products in the Coffee category?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM suppliers T1 JOIN products T2 ON T2.supplier_id = T1.id JOIN categories T3 ON T2.category_id = T3.id WHERE T3.name = 'Coffee'
SELECT T1.name FROM suppliers T1 JOIN products T2 ON T2.supplier_id = T1.id JOIN categories T3 ON T2.category_id = T3.id WHERE T3.name = 'Coffee'

cases.question: List the tea products from cheapest to priciest.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM products T1 JOIN categories T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Tea' ORDER BY T1.price ASC

cases.question: Show employee names by seniority, longest-serving first.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM employees ORDER BY hire_date ASC

cases.question: Give the three most expensive products.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: What is the second highest salary?
gold_sql: SELECT salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

cases.question: Who earns the second highest salary?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

cases.question: Which category has the fewest products?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM products T1 JOIN categories T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which customers have never placed an order?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

cases.question: List the customers without any orders.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

cases.question: Show clients who did not order anything.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

cases.question: Names of customers with no orders at all?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

cases.question: I need the customers that never bought from us.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

cases.question: Find customers who haven't made a single purchase.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

cases.question: Which products have never been ordered?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items)

cases.question: Which customers never ordered any Espresso Beans?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT T1.customer_id FROM orders T1 JOIN order_items T2 ON T2.order_id = T1.id JOIN products T3 ON T3.id = T2.product_id WHERE T3.name = 'Espresso Beans')

cases.question: Which stores have no employees?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM stores WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM employees WHERE store_id IS NOT NULL)

cases.question: Which employees earn more than the average salary of their department?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM employees T1 WHERE T1.salary > (SELECT AVG(T2.salary) FROM employees T2 WHERE T2.department_id = T1.department_id)

cases.question: Which products cost more than the average price?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)

cases.question: What is the most expensive product in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM products T1 WHERE T1.price = (SELECT MAX(T2.price) FROM products T2 WHERE T2.category_id = T1.category_id)
SELECT T2.name, T1.name FROM products T1 JOIN categories T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.id WHERE T1.price = (SELECT MAX(T3.price) FROM products T3 WHERE T3.category_id = T1.category_id)

cases.question: Which departments have an average salary above 5000?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM employees T1 JOIN departments T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id HAVING AVG(T1.salary) > 5000

cases.question: Which customers placed more orders than the average customer?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM customers T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T2.customer_id = T1.id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers) FROM orders)
SELECT T1.name FROM customers T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T2.customer_id = T1.id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders)

cases.question: What are the top 3 categories by average order line value?
gold_sql: SELECT T3.name FROM order_items T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id JOIN categories T3 ON T2.category_id = T3.id GROUP BY T3.id ORDER BY AVG(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Which three categories have the highest average sales amount per order line?
gold_sql: SELECT T3.name FROM order_items T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id JOIN categories T3 ON T2.category_id = T3.id GROUP BY T3.id ORDER BY AVG(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Which customers have no email address?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE email IS NULL

cases.question: How many customers have an email on file?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE email IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(email) FROM customers

cases.question: Which employees have no manager?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL

cases.question: How many shipped orders are there in each region? Most first.
gold_sql: SELECT T3.name, COUNT(*) FROM orders T1 JOIN stores T2 ON T1.store_id = T2.id JOIN regions T3 ON T2.region_id = T3.id WHERE T1.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY T3.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

cases.question: What is the average price of products supplied from France?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.price) FROM products T1 JOIN suppliers T2 ON T1.supplier_id = T2.id WHERE T2.country = 'France'

cases.question: Which store has the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM orders T1 JOIN stores T2 ON T1.store_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many different products has each customer from Paris ordered?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.product_id) FROM customers T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T2.customer_id = T1.id JOIN order_items T3 ON T3.order_id = T2.id WHERE T1.city = 'Paris' GROUP BY T1.id

cases.question: What is the total salary budget of the Sales department?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T1.salary) FROM employees T1 JOIN departments T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Sales'

cases.question: List gold-tier customers who placed at least 5 orders.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM customers T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T2.customer_id = T1.id WHERE T1.loyalty_tier = 'gold' GROUP BY T1.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

cases.question: What is the minimum, maximum and average price of coffee products?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(T1.price), MAX(T1.price), AVG(T1.price) FROM products T1 JOIN categories T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Coffee'

cases.question: Which customers bought both Croissant and Baguette?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM customers T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T2.customer_id = T1.id JOIN order_items T3 ON T3.order_id = T2.id JOIN products T4 ON T4.id = T3.product_id WHERE T4.name = 'Croissant' INTERSECT SELECT T1.name FROM customers T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T2.customer_id = T1.id JOIN order_items T3 ON T3.order_id = T2.id JOIN products T4 ON T4.id = T3.product_id WHERE T4.name = 'Baguette'

cases.question: How many orders did each customer place? Include their names.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, COUNT(*) FROM customers T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T2.customer_id = T1.id GROUP BY T1.id

cases.question: How many orders were placed after 2024-06-30?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date > '2024-06-30'

cases.question: Which customers signed up before March 1, 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date < '2022-03-01'

cases.question: How many orders were placed between 2024-03-01 and 2024-03-31?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31'

cases.question: Show me the products whose names contain the word Tea.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Tea%'

cases.question: How many products are discontinued?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE discontinued = 1

cases.question: Which orders were not shipped? Give their ids.
gold_sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status != 'shipped'

cases.question: Is there any supplier from Brazil? List them.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'Brazil'

cases.question: How many employees report to each manager? Show the manager's name.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name, COUNT(*) FROM employees T1 JOIN employees T2 ON T1.manager_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id
